# Theatricalz
> Pro Camera, Audio & Music Gear Australia

Founded in 2016 in Melbourne, Australia, Theatricalz is an authorized pro cinema, photo, broadcast video, and location audio equipment retailer supplying production houses, DP cinematographers, and creators nationwide.

## Contact & Location
- Address: 3 Kirks Lane, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia
- Phone: +61 489 989 442 (0489 989 442)
- WhatsApp Gear Desk: https://wa.me/61489989442
- Email: sales@theatricalz.com.au
- ABN: 28 614 589 481 · ACN: 614 589 481

## Order Rules & Policies
- Free Shipping: Orders over $500 AUD receive complimentary StarTrack Express freight with transit insurance.
- Shipping Fee: Standard $15 AUD / Express $25 AUD.
- Crypto Discount: 10% instant discount when paying with BTC, USDT, ETH, BNB, or SOL.
- Payment Methods: Cryptocurrency (BTC, USDT, ETH, BNB, SOL), PayID and Australian Bank Transfer (EFT).
- Financing: Pay in 4 interest-free installments on eligible pro equipment.
- Stock Guarantee: 100% Genuine Australian Stock with local manufacturer warranties.

## Product Categories
- [Prop Money](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/prop-money/): Film, TV and stage prop currency for screen productions. All prop notes are clearly marked as props and are not legal tender.
- [Audio Visual](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/audio-visual/): Broadcast converters, fibre and NDI links, switchers, routers, PA systems, conferencing, projectors and test gear for venues, studios and installs.
- [Cables & Connectors](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/cables-connectors/): Pro HDMI, SDI, XLR, USB-C and power cables, adapters and connectors for cameras, audio rigs and broadcast systems.
- [Cases & Bags](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/cases-bags/): Hard cases, wheeled cases, camera backpacks and soft bags that protect cinema, photo and audio gear on set and in transit.
- [Computers](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/computers/): Editing workstations, NVMe storage, RAID arrays, card readers and colour grading panels for post-production workflows.
- [Lighting & Studio](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/lighting-studio/): LED monolights, panel lights, modifiers, light stands and studio grip for film sets, photo studios and content creators.
- [Mobile](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/mobile/): Smartphone gimbals, mobile microphones, phone rigs, lenses and accessories for shooting pro-quality content on mobile.
- [Music & Audio](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/music-audio/): Shotgun and studio microphones, wireless systems, field recorders, mixers, audio interfaces and monitoring headphones.
- [Guitars & Basses](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/guitars-basses/): Acoustic, acoustic-electric, classical, electric and bass guitars, plus ukuleles, cases, strings and accessories from leading makers.
- [Amps & Effects](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/amps-effects/): Guitar and bass amplifiers, speaker cabinets, effects pedals, multi-effects, loopers, pedal power and amp accessories.
- [Drums & Percussion](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/drums-percussion/): Acoustic and electronic drum kits, snares, cymbals, drum heads, pedals, hardware, thrones, sticks and hand percussion.
- [Keys & Synths](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/keys-synths/): Digital and stage pianos, portable keyboards, synthesizers, Eurorack modules, grooveboxes, MIDI controllers and keyboard accessories.
- [Brass & Woodwind](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/brass-woodwind/): Trumpets, trombones, horns, saxophones, clarinets and flutes, plus mouthpieces, mutes, cases, stands, care products and sheet music.
- [DJ & Live Sound](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/dj-live-sound/): DJ controllers, mixers and turntables, PA speakers, column PA, live mixers and in-ear monitoring for performers, venues and events.
- [Outdoor & Optics](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/outdoor-optics/): Binoculars, spotting scopes, rangefinders, torches and outdoor power for location scouting and field production.
- [Photography](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/photography/): Mirrorless camera bodies, lenses, filters, tripods and flashes for professional and enthusiast photographers.
- [Radio & Security](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/radio-security/): Two-way radios, crew comms, intercom headsets and security cameras for production crews, events and venues.
- [Streaming & Podcasting](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/streaming-podcasting/): Podcast microphones, boom arms, streaming encoders, capture cards and webcams for live streams and studio podcasts.
- [Video](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/video/): Cinema cameras, camcorders, monitors, wireless video, gimbals, tripods and rigging for film, broadcast and content production.
